bath_home2_stargazer.text: Mind the telescope. Do not sneeze on it, it is older than my knees.
A man called William Herschel lived just up the road and spotted a new planet from his back garden in 1781. It was Uranus.
He wanted to call it King George's Star. Everybody else said no, thank you.
His sister Caroline found eight comets. In Bath we think she was the clever one. Do not tell the Herschels.
